capabilities: record habit counts and notes in day or week views with habit management and statistics
create, view, and edit diary entries with multiple tags, a timeline, and image pasting
search history by month, year, and tag, and manage topic tags
generate a daily review summarizing habits, logs, tags, images, tasks, and progress
switch between light, dark, and island themes on desktop and mobile
extras: Paid plugin requiring a purchased license; source code is kept in a private repository and the public repo ships release files only. Data is stored in an A_DiaryHabits_Data folder in the vault as Markdown files; the README warns against unofficial builds and explains backup steps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep habit check-ins, journals, topic tags, and a daily review together on a single daily dashboard.
summary: Paid habit tracker and diary workspace that records daily habits, journal entries, tags, tasks, and a daily review on one Obsidian homepage.
